snippet.title: The Pines | Harvest of Terror: A Horror Game Awards Halloween Showcase 2026 Trailer
snippet.description:
A psychological horror RPG where every choice has consequences. After a failed case, former detective Edward Walker arrives at The Pines, a secluded retreat with therapists on site and the promise of peace. But beneath its carefully constructed calm, something is deeply wrong.
---
Originally aired during HARVEST OF TERROR: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Wednesday 7 October 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
